capabilities: Edit frontmatter properties inline with chips, checkboxes and nested dictionaries
Navigate a heading outline with configurable depth and current-heading highlight
Edit footnotes in place and see reference counts and usage context
Flag footnotes with no matching definition or no references
Collapse, expand and refresh sections per note with remembered fold state
extras: Property editing may rewrite frontmatter formatting like the built-in property editor; hand-crafted YAML is best edited in the note itself. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. No network access, telemetry or ads.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's File properties, Outline and Footnotes views stacked in a single side panel
motivation: The author built it while maintaining a personal LLM wiki in the Open Knowledge Format, where checking one note required switching between three views.
problem: Reviewing a note's properties, heading outline and footnotes means hopping between three separate core views.
summary: Sidebar inspector panel that shows and edits the active note's frontmatter properties, heading outline and footnotes in one collapsible view.
